results.title: Controls | Diep.io Wiki | Fandom
results.snippet: Controls are used to direct your Tank and interact with the Diep.io world around it. Note that these controls apply to an English US QWERTY keyboard. Controls may vary from keyboard to keyboard. The following keys allow you to control how your tank moves.

results.title: Diep.io Play now on HahaGames
results.snippet: Diep.io is a free online multiplayer game where players control tanks and battle against each other. The game is a shooter-style game and is available to play in any modern web browser. How to play Diep.io? Control a tank and use it to shoot down other tanks and obstacles in your path.

results.title: Diep io Play on CrazyGames
results.snippet: Diep.io is a survival .io game where you control a circle armed with a cannon.Mouse movement = Aim weapon. Left mouse button = Shoot. Mobile. Use the virtual controllers to move, aim, and shoot. Tap the buttons to upgrade the tank and navigate the game.

results.title: Diep io Play Now for Free | RocketGames
results.snippet: Diep io is a multiplayer tank shooter. Destroy shapes, level up, choose powerful classes, and outplay rivals with smart stats and sharp aiming.Play Diep io by controlling your tank via either wasd keys or arrow keys. Use the mouse cursor to determine which target to destroy.
